name: onepipeline-install-smoke-selection
//: What decides whether test-windows and test-macos run `onepipeline:install-smoke`: `scripts/ci-job.sh` keeps that target in their list only when this project is affected (`scripts/nx-affected.sh --affects`). It runs nothing itself. `installSmokeSelection` and `input-selection` are the one list of what selects it: the files that decide `cargo install --path . --locked` beyond the code. The binary's sources are not on it, because a source change that breaks the install on Windows or macOS fails release.yml's per-platform release build and test-install before anything is published. A version-only Cargo edit is dropped by `scripts/nx-version-free-selection.mjs` (the `selection:version-free` tag); a dependency moved or added still selects it.

test.//: The selection this project answers is driven by .github/ci-shape/install-proofs.test.mjs, and the proof it selects is the crate's install-smoke.

input-selection.//: Selection-only edges: Nx affected reads a target's file inputs as project touches. A version-only Cargo edit is dropped from this project's selection by scripts/nx-version-free-selection.mjs.
